rendering_note: This display-only projection retains complete aromatic bond-connected systems containing active aromatic atoms, removes unchanged substituents from aromatic carbon, and replaces omitted non-aromatic frameworks with R. Non-carbon atoms multiply bonded directly to active atoms remain explicit so functional handles such as C=O, S=O, P=O, C=N, and C=N triple bond are not converted to R. Aromatic heteroatom attachments are retained as R when deletion could change valence or charge.
